connectors.name: IIC/UART JST connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal connector, started at the end closest to the USB Type-C connector (right end, IO43) and went left.

connectors.name: IDC 2x4 header
connectors.orderNote: Silkscreen beside the header prints pin numbers 1, 2, 7, 8 with a pin table (1 SCL, 2 SDA, IO17/IO16, GND/GND, 7 GND, 8 3V3); followed that numbering (odd = lower row SCL/IO17/GND/GND, even = upper row SDA/IO16/GND/3V3), consistent with the callout rows and the square pad at lower-left.

connectors.name: Extra holes right of the IDC 2x4 header
connectors.orderNote: Not numbered; ordered upper-row hole first, then lower-row holes left to right (top/left rule).

unreadable: IO0x/IO4x names: O vs 0 not distinguishable; 0 used.
uncertain: IDC area: the photo shows 5 upper-row and 6 lower-row holes and the callout lists 5 upper (SDA IO16 GND 3V3 IO40) and 6 lower (SCL IO17 GND GND IO38 IO41) names, while the text says "IDC 2x4" and the silkscreen table covers only 8 pins. The 8 numbered pins were kept as idc-2x4; IO40 (upper 5th), IO38 (lower 5th), IO41 (lower 6th) were mapped to the extra holes by position in the callout and grouped separately - the grouping and whether IO41 belongs to the speaker connector instead are unclear.
notes: Function-only lists (LCD, ES7210, I2S, TF card, encoder, APA102) have no physical positions and were skipped. Speaker JST 1.25 and JST-GH 1.25mm connectors have no individually labeled pins; USB-C and buttons skipped.
